original_test_intent: Verify that the identified CX9 high-speed interconnect cable can undergo one qualified disconnect/reconnect, retain correct endpoint pairing, latch and routing, and restore its exact endpoint/link state without new physical or protocol errors.
original_method: Freeze cable PN/serial/type/length and both CX9 board-port endpoints, orientation/keying, latch and route; capture physical and link/error baselines; put both endpoints in the vendor-required de-energized state; a qualified technician services only this cable once using connector housings and ESD controls; on restore, prove the same endpoint pair, expected negotiated link and clean link/error/event state rather than relying on generic device visibility.
manual_activity: A qualified technician inspects and reconnects the single approved CX9 cable after placing both endpoints in the vendor-approved service state.
required_inputs: CX9 cable PN/serial/type/length and exact endpoint board/port pair
Orientation/keying, latch, bend-radius and routing requirements
Vendor connector handling, ESD and both-endpoint power-isolation procedure
Expected CX9 endpoint identity, negotiated link attributes and error/event limits
safety_requirements: Confirm both link endpoints are safe for service before unlatching
Grip only specified connector housings and observe keying, latch and bend radius
Label and photograph endpoints and route before removal
Stop on damage, resistance, swapped orientation, incomplete latch, missing endpoint, link degradation or new error
Do not repeat the cycle or automatically retrain/reset a failed link
agent_execution_scope: Validate cable/path identity, service state and CX9 link oracle
Collect unique pre/post link/error evidence and technician-provided photos
Correlate timestamps and preserve raw events without physical inference
Do not handle connectors, reset/retrain links, clear logs, borrow BF4/board evidence or assign verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact CX9 cable endpoint pair and one disconnect/reconnect cycle
Approve dual-end power/ESD/handling procedure, link criteria and recovery
Review physical/link evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike the prior BF4 cable, this item names a CX9 link whose two endpoints and negotiated attributes must be independently bound. A cable can be visible yet partially latched or operating at degraded width/speed. The review therefore requires a dual-end service state, labeled pairing and link-training/error oracle.
